chapters.label: Observe
chapters.text: Observe both open cases before their contents are hidden.
chapters.evidenceText: The open cases reveal which item is inside each case and where each case starts.

chapters.label: Goal 1
chapters.text: Move the case containing the USB drive to the left tray.
chapters.evidenceText: The exposed USB drive identifies the case before its lid closes.

chapters.label: Goal 2
chapters.text: Move the case containing the SD card to the right tray.
chapters.evidenceText: The visible SD card identifies the second case before its lid closes.

chapters.label: Goal 3
chapters.text: Return the USB case to its original position.
chapters.evidenceText: The opening view shows the USB case’s return destination before it was moved to the tray.

chapters.label: Observe
chapters.text: Observe where both toys start before they are gathered in the left tray.
chapters.evidenceText: The blue toy and yellow chick start at separate positions on the desk.

chapters.label: Goal 1
chapters.text: Move the blue toy to the right tray.
chapters.evidenceText: The first view shows the blue toy before it is gathered with the chick in the left tray.

chapters.label: Goal 2
chapters.text: Brush the blue toy’s original spot, then put the brush back.
chapters.evidenceText: The blue toy is now in the tray. Its earlier position identifies where to brush.

chapters.label: Goal 3
chapters.text: Return the blue toy to its original position.
chapters.evidenceText: The same earlier position gives the return destination. The robot picks up the toy from its current tray.
